summary: Williams Companies filed an 8-K reporting completion on September 10, 2026 of a registered senior notes offering totaling $2.75 billion: $500 million 5.000% notes due 2029, $1.0 billion 5.600% notes due 2033, $750 million 5.800% notes due 2036 and $500 million 6.400% notes due 2056, issued under a base indenture with Bank of New York Mellon Trust as trustee and a fourteenth supplemental indenture. Notes are senior unsecured, pari passu with other senior debt, with semi-annual interest and customary lien and merger covenants. This is routine debt capital markets activity, not a special situation; watch leverage and refinancing economics.
